description_en: Queries the synchronization scope of an identity provider
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-identity-provider-sync-scope --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIdentityProviderSyncScope

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace to which the identity provider belongs
parameters.help_zh: 身份源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity provider. DingTalk indicates DingTalk, and Feishu indicates Lark
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型。DingTalk 表示钉钉，Feishu 表示飞书
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

code.description_en: The business status code of the API request. SUCCESS indicates that the request is successful, but does not indicate that the asynchronous synchronization task is completed
code.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的业务状态码。SUCCESS 表示本次请求成功，不表示异步同步任务已经完成

data.description_en: The business data returned by the request
data.description_zh: 本次请求返回的业务数据

estimateStatus.description_en: The estimation status of the user count for the synchronization scope. The count is available only when the status is Ready. A missing count in other states cannot be considered as 0
estimateStatus.description_zh: 同步范围的人数预估状态。仅 Ready 时数量可用；其他状态下缺失数量不能视为 0

estimatedUserCount.description_en: The estimated number of users in the saved synchronization scope. This parameter is returned only when estimateStatus is Ready and the downstream system provides the value. It does not represent the number of users that have been synchronized
estimatedUserCount.description_zh: 已保存同步范围的用户数量预估；仅在 estimateStatus=Ready 且下游提供该值时返回。不代表已经同步的人数

expandedDepartmentCount.description_en: The estimated number of departments including sub-departments. This parameter is returned only when estimateStatus is Ready and the downstream system provides the value
expandedDepartmentCount.description_zh: 包含子部门的部门数量预估；仅在 estimateStatus=Ready 且下游提供该值时返回

selectedDepartments.description_en: The names and validity of the saved selected departments. This parameter can be an empty array when the mode is AllAuthorized. An empty array does not indicate that the organization has no departments
selectedDepartments.description_zh: 已保存选择的部门名称和有效性。AllAuthorized 时可为空数组；为空不表示组织没有部门

exists.description_en: Indicates whether the selected department still exists. A value of false indicates that the selection is invalid and the synchronization scope must be reconfirmed
exists.description_zh: 所选部门当前是否仍存在；false 表示该选择已失效，需重新确认同步范围

id.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider. When querying the sub-departments of this node, use this value as parentDepartmentId
id.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识。查询该节点的子部门时，将此值作为 parentDepartmentId

name.description_en: The name of the department returned by the identity provider
name.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门名称

syncScope.description_en: The saved synchronization scope downstream. AllAuthorized indicates the address book scope authorized for the application
syncScope.description_zh: 下游已保存的同步范围；AllAuthorized 表示应用获授权的通讯录范围

departmentIds.description_en: When the mode is SelectedDepartments, this parameter contains at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this parameter
departmentIds.description_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en: The scope mode. Valid values: AllAuthorized (the entire authorized scope, limited by the application's address book authorization) and SelectedDepartments (the selected departments and all their sub-departments). When explicitly submitting syncScope, a valid mode must be provided and verified by the backend
mode.description_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the API request. It does not indicate the execution result of the asynchronous task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的 HTTP 状态码，不表示异步任务的执行结果

message.description_en: The response message of the API request
message.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的响应消息

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求的唯一标识。排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful. To check whether the asynchronous task is completed, query the task status
success.description_zh: 本次 API 请求是否成功。异步任务是否完成应查询任务状态
